process_lessons.lesson: Byte identity and execution economics are independent gates.
Verify native build-profile parity before attribution.
When charged causal components are neutral but one whole-process timing cell is red, replicate the unchanged full gate before inventing optimization.
Clean-installed and cross-authored archive tests expose OS I/O semantics that codec-only portability tests miss.
Compatibility metadata should claim exactly the interpreter family/minors demonstrated by the same final artifact.
When runtime ownership moves into a package-owned native artifact, historical worktree comparators must materialize that artifact for both candidate and base before performance evidence is valid.
Refresh strongest-current comparator engines before assuming historical dominance transfers; provenance-only refresh can reveal real product debt even when semantics and evaluator stay fixed.
When a research floor is much smaller than canonical fallback but cannot be published under canonical grammar, price productization/subsumption headroom before inventing another compressor.
Separate compression representation debt from speculative-search create debt; the same losing row can have a sub-second canonical fallback and tens of seconds of non-publishable research work.
